entityDescription:
Form International is a forest management and services company that manages forest assets in Africa and delivers a range of technical and financial services to clients worldwide. Assets under management for our clients encompass 27,000 hectares of sustainable forest plantations, forest restoration, nature conservation and agroforestry in Ghana and Tanzania. The focus is on the restoration of degraded forest lands into productive, ecologically and socially functioning landscapes.

The operations in Ghana and Tanzania are set up as separate enterprises and the Dutch mother company is Sustainable Forest Investment B.V.. 
Form International B.V. is no shareholder in Form Ghana Ltd. or SFI Tanzania Ltd., but does provide the management and technical assistance as a service to these local enterprises under a long term cooperation agreement.

Note: legally Form International B.V. is majority shareholder in a company in Tanzania, namely Form Tanzania Ltd. Yet, this company is in the process of being dissolved.

entityName: Spacebridge Inc. (formerly known as Advantech Wireless Inc.)
entityDescription:
Founded in 1985, SpaceBridge Inc. is an established supplier and global market leader in broadband satellite communications systems technology. Previously known as Advantech Wireless Inc., the company is now doing business as SpaceBridge Inc.
Headquartered in Montreal, Canada, SpaceBridge Inc. is well positioned to meet the demands of today’s global market, with two affiliate R&D offshore innovation centers. Sales, and support offices, as well as remote offices in: Brazil, Colombia, United Kingdom, the Middle East, Indonesia, China, and Russia. SpaceBridge is an ISO9001 registered vendor.
The company develops and provides satellite network equipment and services, including VSAT HUBs and Terminals for Point-to-Point, Point-to-Multi-Point, and Mesh topologies, as well as SCPC and broadcast modems for GEO and NGSO satellite constellations.
SpaceBridge Inc. also provides Cloud-Based autonomous managed services for its customers, helping them to eliminate initial large Capex investments and save on network management Opex, while speeding time-to-market.
SpaceBridge Inc.’s diverse portfolio includes the ASAT™ product line, which serves different verticals with various technologies and applications. Key areas of focus are: Cellular Backhaul for 2G/3G/4G and 5G, Industrial Internet of Things-IIoT, Commercial and Military Satcoms-On-The-Move, High-Speed Broadband, Multicast IPTV, Voice-over-IP, Videoconferencing, L2/L3 VPN, Virtual Network Operator, and HD/UHD TV Broadcasting.
SpaceBridge Inc. first introduced its ASAT™ WaveSwitch™ technology to the market in 2015. This innovative, award-winning technology enables dynamic return link selection and switching to the most-appropriate waveform, whether MF-TDMA, ASCPC or SCPC, thereby optimizing satellite resource usage for satellite networks and operators.
As new NGSO/LEO/MEO satellite constellations revolutionize the satellite market, SpaceBridge Inc. is working in close partnership with New-Space players to advance the satellite communications landscape by developing VSAT technology to exploit next-gen leaps in capacity, and deliver 4G, 5G backhauling, IIoT and many other applications for our customers.
SpaceBridge Inc. continues to enhance its innovative architecture to not only meet today’s satellite challenges in managing ground and space satellite resources, but also to provide superior solutions that address the New-Space satellite challenges of tomorrow.

entityDescription:
Company profile NEDAERO

NEDAERO, based in The Netherlands at two locations, Zevenaar and Alphen aan den Rijn specializes in the manufacturing, repair (MRO) and distribution of components and systems for civil and military aircraft and helicopters. We service a broad range of platforms, our focus platforms are ATR and Dash8, AS350/Écureuil, F-16, NH90 and PUMA helicopters.

At the Zevenaar facility, NEDAERO manufactures new parts (for Airbus and Lockheed Martin). In fully equipped workshops with high-tech production - and test-equipment NEDAERO ensures that all components are being delivered in accordance with the highest standards and expectations within the Aerospace Industry. 
With over 40 years of manufacturing and MRO experience, NEDAERO has the expertise to provide its customers with proactive advice and technical support helping to ensure the most cost effective support solutions are provided to its civil and military customers worldwide. 
From the Alphen aan den Rijn facility, NEDAERO delivers helicopter and aircraft parts directly from distribution stock. Our products range from transceivers to life vests, from actuators to headsets and from oil & greases to a wide range of filters. We hold an exchange pool for ATR and AS350 Écureuil parts. In addition to this logistic support we also offer broad expertise to military governmental organizations and private military MRO companies. 
For further details on products and capabilities please go to our website www.nedaero.com

Certificates: Part 145, AS9100, AS9110, AS9120, EASA/FAA/TCCA, ISO9001:2015

entityDescription:
Intelligent Software Solutions Global Limited (ISS Global Ltd) are comprised of a team of industry veterans with decades of real-world experience. This subject matter expertise combined with world class software development allow us to deliver products and solutions that drive a commitment we share with our customers – making the world a safer place. Our team stands stand at the forefront of cybersecurity. Comprehensive, converged offering of technologies and tools expose system and network vulnerabilities, anticipating and neutralizing threats wherever they lie – land, sea, air, cyberspace, or outer space. From large-scale cybersecurity programs to immediate deployment and rapid assistance, our proven security methods reflect our customer-first approach, innovative mindset, and effective execution style. We’re on the cutting edge of cybersecurity innovation, working with machine learning and artificial intelligence–based technologies to help mitigate the cyber threat. Clients trust us to protect their critical assets through services such as integrated electronic security systems, integrated enterprise physical security systems, and threat vulnerability assessments and mitigation.

Our space and operations support programs boost service component leads in space. We provide systems engineering, advisory, and technical services for space satellite systems that encompass defence satellite communications systems (DSCS), global positioning systems (GPS), space based infrared systems (SBIRS), third generation infrared sensors (3GIRS), and the Defence Meteorological Support Program (DMSP). Our experts led the advisory services team responsible for the Commercially Hosted IR Payload (CHIRP) launch. Our key Space capabilities include: specifications and standards development, training, tools development, mission assurance, mission support, test and evaluation, modernization, critical technology and industrial base assessment, physical security, and program protection. Our expertise and services are critical to space launch operations cybersecurity and the underlying disciplines of information systems security and communications security implementation for space systems.

entityName: +ATLANTIC - Association for an Atlantic Collaborative Laboratory
entityDescription:
The Atlantic plays a key role in the strategy to face major societal challenges: Climate Change, Environmental Sustainability, and Energy and Food availability. Major circulation changes during the last thousands of years had large impact on global climate and led to reorganizations of the planet’s ecosystems; the enhanced warming of regions of the north Atlantic will also have major consequences for the marine ecosystems asking for better monitoring and follow-up. Pressures arising from human activities related with coastal urban expansion, fisheries and deep-sea mining need to be quantified and mitigated. Marine renewal energy systems will expand quickly to ensure long term decarbonisation and their operation needs to be supported with minimum harm to the natural systems. The ocean is and will remain critical for the future food supply of humanity. 
This Collaborative Laboratory (CoLAB) for the Atlantic (+Atlantic), which was formally approved by the Portuguese Science and Technology Foundation (FCT) on January 30th 2018, created on May 2018 and initiated its activity on April 14th 2019, targets the challenges put forward by the Atlantic Interactions initiative materialized in the Atlantic International Research Center (AIR Center) through a 5 year plan. The +Atlantic CoLAB will constitute an important node of the AIR Center as well as of the recently created Portuguese Space Agency (Portugal Space).
+Atlantic is a non-profit private association comprising, at the moment of writing, 13 Portuguese members (7 enterprises, 2 universities and 4 non-profit associations of scientific nature or public utility) of different areas of the country and different backgrounds. The latter range from robotics (submarine and aerial), climate modelling and renewable energies to satellites and remote sensing services.
The CoLAB for the Atlantic aims at advancing knowledge on the interactions between the Ocean, Atmosphere, Climate and Energy in the Atlantic, with an integrated approach from deep sea to space. The idea is to develop a better understanding of the Atlantic system, to prepare for the sustainable use of its resources and to create a framework to unleash its potential for Society, promoting blue growth and highly qualified employment. 
The dynamics of these interactions are extremely complex and no single organisation is prepared to tackle them appropriately. Hence, demanding an overarching approach that cannot be achieved without a broad engagement of different stakeholders, able to address the breadth of issues being dealt by the CoLAB. The CoLAB will build on advanced research in Space, Ocean and Energy technologies, as well as in Data Science, to foster the production of new knowledge about the ocean and its interactions as well as the development and deployment of new infrastructures and platforms that will provide new sources of data for the Atlantic, leading to new research strategies. 
The CoLAB will build on the expertise of its founders that, together with a new highly qualified team of researchers and the integrated operation of existing and new infrastructures, will address the major challenges lying ahead for the future of the Atlantic system. Overall, the CoLAB will be advancing knowledge and providing value added services to enhance the sustainable exploration and exploitation of this global resource. 
All CoLAB activities fall within one or more of its 5 scientific priorities:
•	Axis 1: Sustainability of marine resources
•	Axis 2: Atlantic observation and monitoring
•	Axis 3: Impact of climate change on the Atlantic
•	Axis 4: Future technologies for the Oceans
•	Axis 5: Data science and Big Data
All CoLAB activities aim to contribute directly to value creation, be it through the production of new knowledge which can support market research and development strategies or through oriented actions focused on the creation of a portfolio of products and services that can be exploited with the CoLAB members.

Commendium is a 3D data acquisition and processing company specialising in the
capture and processing of 3D data from remote, difficult, and potentially hazardous
environments such as caves, mines, mountains, forests, deserts, underwater and
industrially hazardous locations. We have been mapping underground locations all over
the world including karstic caves and basaltic lava tubes all over the world for many
years and within the speleological world, now have a reputation for high quality work.
Our work can be for scientific, engineering, entertainment or conservational goals. We
have used a wide range of technology to assist us including, LiDAR (both airborne and
terrestrial), photogrammetrics as well as traditional theodolite and tape and compass
work. Most recently we mapped Tham Luang Cave, the cave in Thailand where 12 boys
and their coach were trapped for almost three weeks, in 3D for national geographic, to
create 3D graphics to illustrate the cave and how the rescue was conducted.

entityDescription:
Kathy founded Carrak Consulting Ltd to provide a range of geo-environmental services to land and mineral developers seeking to adopt SMART solutions to the responsible management of natural resources and wastes.
Kathy is a mining geologist and chartered environmentalist with sixteen year’s consultancy experience on natural resource projects in the UK and overseas. Carrak Consulting Ltd provides environmental management and sustainable development tools for proposed and operational mines. In the UK the company specialises in mining legacy issues, specifically the assessment of land affected by mineral development and wastes. Kathy is well acquainted with baseline conditions and specific issues at many former mine sites in environmentally sensitive locations across Cornwall.
In 2018 Carrak Consulting Ltd was part of a multi-disciplinary team, including the British Geological Survey, Satellite Applications Catapult and Camborne School of Mines (University of Exeter), involved in a project using earth observation data to identify mineral signatures, vegetation characteristics and land cover types in Cornwall. 
Carrak Consulting Ltd is experienced in ESIA project management, preparing technical due diligence reports and advising on environmentally and socially responsible practices throughout all stages of a project lifecycle. She is conversant with international standards, including those of Equator Principle Financial Institutions and has experience of working in the EU, Russia, Central Asia and the Caucasus. 
Carrak Consulting Ltd employs specialist Associates and works with members of the Cornwall Mining Alliance to provide bespoke consultancy packages. The company has a wide range of industry and public sector contacts and provides services including:
•	Environmental monitoring; management plans & systems
•	Permitting support & compliance monitoring
•	Environmental & social capacity building
•	Environmental impact, risk & liability assessments
•	Due diligence & technical reporting
•	Environmental audits, fatal flaw analysis & action planning
•	Research and project management

entityDescription:
Over the years, Barrnon has developed an enviable reputation for great engineering ideas that are brilliantly executed and then applied in some of the world’s most challenging environments.
We started with exceptionally durable scallop fishing gear – which we still sell to happy fishermen all over the UK. We then took our knowledge of the rigours of trawling and transferred it to some huge problems in the nuclear decommissioning industry.Through our subsidiary company, Kapwell Technologies, we’re now applying insight from the nuclear industry to tackle a considerable challenge for the Oil & Gas sector. We are now at the centre of some of the world’s most demanding industries, delivering innovative engineering solutions that get the job done. 
Barrnon is a boutique engineering services provider based in the quiet Cumbrian town of Appleby. Led by Managing Director, Andy Barr, we don’t just create imaginative engineering solutions to the most complex problems, we also manufacture them on site.
We are exceptionally competent when working with metal, using state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques to bring our innovative 3D CAD designs to life in our extensive workshop.Our unique combination of skills has given us the opportunity to partner with some of the biggest names in engineering around the world – and to take our branded products into specialist markets including nuclear decommissioning in Japan, the USA and the UK.
